infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RaceBuddy needs location access to track your lap times and provide GPS-based racing features.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: RaceBuddy needs background location access to continuously track your position during racing sessions.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: RaceBuddy needs background location access to track your racing data and provide telemetry during sessions.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: RaceBuddy needs motion sensor access to measure G-forces and provide telemetry data during racing.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow RaceBuddy to access your location so it can track lap times and GPS racing data.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow RaceBuddy to use your location to track lap times and racing data.
